## Built 2026-10-26 (bundled with GEN-893)

- **Docs check first, as the next action asked.** https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills says the combined `description` and `when_to_use` text "is truncated at 1,536 characters in the skill listing", and that a command file "accepts the same fields except `name` and `paths`". It does not name command files under the cap in so many words, so this coverage is by inference. The one command file, `loghistory`, does appear in the skill listing.
- **The size checker** (`~/.claude/skills/config-health/config-health-scan.ps1`) has a new `-CommandsDir` parameter (default `~/.claude/commands`) and a `command` class for its `*.md` files.
  - Each command's description plus `when_to_use` is measured against the 1,536-character listing cap, and its description against the 1,024 portable note. Both are skipped when `disable-model-invocation: true`.
  - A command with no frontmatter, or no or an empty description, gets a note instead of a measurement, because the listing then uses other text.
  - Commands are included in `-Action size-sweep`, and `-Action size-check` classifies them.
- **Thresholds file.** `notes/anthropic-guidelines.json`: the two description limits' `appliesTo` text now names command files and says the coverage is inferred (GEN-926).
- **Acceptance met.**
  - A fixture command with a 1,600-character description is reported as a breach.
  - The sweep lists command files' findings.
  - Fixtures with `disable-model-invocation`, no frontmatter and no description behave as described.
  - Tests: `notes/gen893/size-lines-test.js`, 44 of 44 passed.
  - Live: the sweep now measures 66 files (one more than before, `loghistory.md`). `loghistory` description is 305 of 1,536 characters, with no finding.
- **Vetting.** Done through /vet-code with GEN-893 Part 1: an in-session review and an independent Opus review (PASS). Installed byte-identical on 2026-10-26.

Title and description re-read against what was built: they match. Priority unchanged: Not-urgent, Gain ratio 2, Medium.

**Status:** Done.
